answer: Physical Substrate Attestation. Each agent identity must harbor a unique, factory-laser-etched silicon PUF whose challenge-response is verified at enrollment; the registry rejects any key whose PUF fingerprint collides at a shared vertex across identities. Operators cannot clone the substrate, so each identity costs a distinct fabricated chip plus physical provisioning. A yarrow-seeded audit samples live PUFs, and a flagged clone forfeits the operator's whole enrolled set.
